instruction.text: Vervollständige den Dialog von Chiara und Naveen über ihre Ferien.

atoms.b: Hello Chiara! How ((++were was)) your holidays?
atoms.sound: Hello Chiara! How were your holidays?

atoms.a: Hi Naveen! Sie waren toll! Und deine? Was hast du gemacht?
atoms.b: Hi Naveen! They were ((++great bad))! And yours? ((++What How)) did you do?
atoms.sound: Hi Naveen! They were great. And yours? What did you do?

atoms.a: Meine Ferien waren schön. Ich verbrachte viel Zeit mit meiner Familie und Freunden. Wir fuhren oft zum See oder spielten Fußball.
atoms.b: My holidays were nice. I ((++spent spends)) a lot of time with my family and friends. We often ((++went go)) to the lake or played football.
atoms.sound: My holidays were nice. I spent a lot of time with my family and friends. We often went to the lake or played football.

atoms.a: Cool. Ich war mit meinen Eltern auch am See. Aber die meiste Zeit verbrachte ich mit meiner Freundin Marsha im Ferienlager.
atoms.b: Cool. I ((++was am)) at the lake with my parents, too. But I spent most of the time with my ((++friend sister)) Marsha at the holiday camp.
atoms.sound: Cool. I was at the lake with my parents, too. But I spent most of the time with my friend Marsha at holiday camp.

atoms.b: And ((++what who)) did you do there?
atoms.sound: And what did you do there?

atoms.a: Wir haben viele Dinge gemacht. Wir machten Lagerfeuer, fuhren Boot und wir haben ebenfalls Fußball gespielt.
atoms.b: We ((++did does)) many things. We ((++made make)) campfires, drove a boat and also played football.
atoms.sound: We did many things. We made campfires, drove a boat and also played football.

atoms.a: Das hört sich toll an. Das möchte ich nächstes Jahr auch machen. Wie war das Wetter?
atoms.b: That sounds ((++great boring)). I want to do that next year, too. ((++How Who)) was the weather?
atoms.sound: That sounds great. I want to do that next year, too. How was the weather?

atoms.a: Wir können nächstes Jahr zusammen fahren! Das Wetter war meistens gut. Wenn es geregnet hat, haben wir Spiele gespielt.
atoms.b: We can go together next year! The weather was usually good. When it ((++rained rains)), we ((++played play)) games.
atoms.sound: We can go together next year! The weather was usually good. When it rained, we played games.

atoms.a: Das wäre toll. Hier war es auch regnerisch. Mein Freund Tobias und ich haben dann einen Filmabend gemacht.
atoms.b: That would be great. It was ((++rainy sunny)) here, too. My friend Tobias and I then ((++had has)) a film night.
atoms.sound: That would be great. It was rainy here too, so my friend Tobias and I had a film night.
